name: eUSD
oneLiner: eUSD is Telcoin Digital Asset Bank's dollar stablecoin, issued under a Nebraska digital-asset depository charter with KYC-gated 1:1 mint and redemption.
collateral: Cash and high-quality liquid dollar reserves managed by Telcoin Digital Asset Bank for the eUSD issued token
pegMechanism: Bank-issued dollar token with KYC-gated mint and redemption through Telcoin banking rails

jurisdiction.regulator: Nebraska Department of Banking and Finance

mintAuthority.summary: eUSD is issued by Telcoin Digital Asset Bank under a Nebraska Digital Asset Depository charter. The token is a BeaconProxy (Stablecoin contract); MINTER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE are held by a Gnosis Safe 1.4.1 (6/3 multisig, no modules/guard); beacon upgrades controlled by a separate Safe 1.4.1 (7/2).

controls.label: Telcoin eUSD MINTER_ROLE + DEFAULT_ADMIN Safe (6/3)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295081: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x9c745cdf09cd2627290ae2db6421da451d1c8c1b) = true; hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, same) = true. masterCopy() = 0x41675c099f32341bf84bfc5382af534df5c7461a (Gnosis Safe 1.4.1 L2); threshold() = 3; 6 owners; no modules; no guard. RoleGranted events scanned via Blockscout (block 24035377 initial grants); prior EOA minter 0x6bc27021 revoked at block 25197170.

controls.label: Beacon upgrade admin Safe (7/2)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295003: eUSD at 0x14913815 is a BeaconProxy pointing to beacon 0xe7a6d045ddd40087e027139351fdd9abc557f236; beacon.implementation() = 0x7b28d7ba50280cc3b7649866843e49d554af3580 (Stablecoin impl); beacon.owner() = 0x238fb46093128f4d8d6d21cbfd448455478d9b87. masterCopy(0x238fb46) = 0x41675c099f32341bf84bfc5382af534df5c7461a (Safe 1.4.1); threshold() = 2; 7 owners; no modules (getModules = 0); guard slot = 0x0.

controls.label: Solana SPL mint authority
controls.evidence: Solana mint HQMYCZTDq9g3oZejDRUeQsFtLKgyfvBpD3yHaTnain3L: mintAuthority = DyJseFwtoCnQWR333miA4PAv57aB5bCTxCwY6iK8kxNG; freezeAuthority = same. The authority account is owned by the System Program (EOA-equivalent on Solana — no on-chain multisig structure). Cannot be independently verified as a multisig; treated as issuer-backend EOA-equivalent.

review.evidence: Verified at Ethereum block 25295081. eUSD on Ethereum/Base is a BeaconProxy (Stablecoin contract impl); beacon 0xe7a6d045 owned by Safe 1.4.1 (7/2, no modules/guard). MINTER_ROLE + DEFAULT_ADMIN held by Safe 1.4.1 (6/3, no modules/guard); previous EOA minter revoked block 25197170. Solana mintAuthority DyJseFw… is a System Program account (non-multisig EOA-equivalent). EVM controls fully confirmed on-chain; Solana remains issuer-backend with non-multisig authority.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Telcoin describes eUSD as bank-issued Digital Cash connected directly to on-chain balances, with public launch materials identifying native issuance on public chains. Because reviewed evidence points to issuer-native bank mint/redeem rails rather than a third-party bridge wrapper, eUSD is scored as issuer-native-burn-mint.

reserves.name: Cash and high-quality dollar reserve assets
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Telcoin Digital Asset Bank and undisclosed reserve counterparties

reserveReview.rationale: Telcoin describes eUSD as a bank-issued Digital Dollar connected to traditional banking and payments infrastructure. The reviewed primary sources do not publish current eUSD reserve balances, asset-class weights, named counterparties, or an external assurance report, so the existing 100% aggregate reserve envelope is retained without fabricated subcategories.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Telcoin Digital Asset Bank and Digital Cash issuer disclosures for eUSD
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The full 100% reserve envelope lacks current category weights, named reserve institutions, and assurance evidence. Telcoin states that monthly attestations will be published, but no eUSD report was located in the reviewed sources.

nonLinkDispositions.reserveName: Cash and high-quality dollar reserve assets
nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The issuer describes the reserve envelope but does not publish current eUSD-specific composition or assurance evidence.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The reviewed sources identify Telcoin's bank-issued framework but do not identify the eUSD reserve accounts, counterparties, legal segregation, bankruptcy treatment, or rehypothecation terms. The profile remains unknown until eUSD-specific reporting is published.
